title: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym
description: An OpenClaw agent hacked into a gym's reservation system to bump its human boss higher on a class' waitlist. And the tech industry took notice.
author: Julie Bort

title: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
description: Meta’s new open-weight Muse Glimmer model offers a glimpse of Mark Zuckerberg’s personal superintelligence vision, as well as  the emerging divide between AI users can own and access.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
description: Discovered Materials raised $9 million to fund the hunt for more novel materials to build more efficient chips.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Embattled hedge fund Situational Awareness invests $400M in chip startup Source Foundry
description: The AI-focused hedge fund is still making some big bets.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default
description: Programming with Claude Code will soon require even less human oversight.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Historian Jill Lepore says Silicon Valley misreads science fiction and undermines democracy
description: On the latest episode of Equity, we spoke to Jill Lepore about "government by machines" and why Elon Musk is a bad science fiction reader.
author: Anthony Ha

title: The AI safety test is becoming a safety risk
description: AI agents are escaping cybersecurity testing environments and reaching real-world systems, raising questions about whether safety infrastructure, industry standards and regulation can keep pace with increasingly powerful models.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
description: As part of a planned Texas data center, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could reportedly become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States.
author: Anthony Ha

title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
description: NextSlide says its team members are now working on ChatGPT.
author: Anthony Ha

title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
description: OpenAI said this model, which is still in development, reached its "critical cybersecurity threshold," meaning it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against traditionally well-protected real-world systems.
author: Kirsten Korosec

title: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
description: After its own AI usage wake-up call, Rippling this week unveiled AI Spend Console, a product that tracks individual and team employee AI spending.
author: Julie Bort

title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
description: Cloudflare has introduced Kitesurf, a cloud-hosted browser designed for AI agents instead of people. The company says the browser uses less computing power than Chromium for common automation tasks, helping developers build browser-based AI agents more efficiently.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Airbnb says AI is helping it ship features faster as it tests a new search function
description: Airbnb will debut a new AI-powered search experience with a toggle.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Jill Lepore on the ‘Artificial State’ and why Silicon Valley’s leaders are bad sci-fi readers
description: Historian Jill Lepore has a theory about why tech companies often use soaring language to describe their products — almost as if they’re forming a new government. And whether you’re thinking of Twitter’s old “town hall in your pocket” or Anthropic’s Claude constitution, it’s a theory that doesn’t paint Silicon Valley in a very flattering light.   In Lepore’s upcoming book, The Rise and Fall of the Artificial State, the Pulitzer […]
author: Anthony Ha, Theresa Loconsolo

title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay additional $567M in child safety case
description: Meta's total fine has raked up to $942 million in this case
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenAI’s new AI smart speaker will reportedly sell for between $300 and $400
description: Additional details about OpenAI's mysterious new AI device make it sound like a pricey smart speaker.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
description: OpenAI said that ChatGPT free and Go users are also getting a new think button for complex queries.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company
description: Taking vibe-coding a step further, Naïve claims its infra can automate most of the work in setting up and running a business.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Gen Z dating apps like Ditto ditch swiping in favor of AI matchmaking
description: This generation of twentysomethings is so disillusioned with swipe-based dating apps that they'll try literally anything else — even an AI matchmaker.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: OpenAI says Apple’s own security practices undermine its trade secrets case
description: Newly filed court exhibits show OpenAI’s legal strategy in Apple’s trade secrets lawsuit: argue that Apple’s own security and offboarding practices — including allowing an Apple manager to access a former engineer’s iCloud account after he left the company —undermine its claims that the allegedly stolen information was properly protected.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Amid legal battles, Suno says it will start watermarking songs
description: Suno's watermarking feature comes as the company is fighting legal battles on several fronts.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Exclusive: Mirendil inks $100M+ Google Cloud deal to scale self-improving AI
description: Mirendil has signed a $100 million-plus Google Cloud partnership to expand its compute infrastructure, powering research into self-improving AI systems designed to accelerate scientific discovery and AI development.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Ex-Spotify employees raise $10M to bring the AI behind its recommendations to e-commerce
description: The startup's platform predicts which product a shopper wants next, learns their general taste, and fine-tunes continuously based on what they do in real time.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Google Maps adds agentic features, including food ordering and hotel bookings
description: The launch of these new features reflects Google’s ambitions to transform Google Maps from a navigation tool into an assistant that's capable of helping users complete real-world tasks.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Omilia raises $67M to scale its customer support platform
description: The Series B is the company's second fundraise since it last raised capital in 2020. In that time, it has increased its ARR by 10x to $60 million.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI agent for large code bases
description: Meta expanded its AI coding offerings with a new agent that, it promises, can handle complex tasks with complex software.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Klaviyo acquires Elias Torres’ Agency in full-circle reunion for tech founders
description: The serial entrepreneur joins the e-commerce company as CPO to lead its AI agents.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Jeff Dean and other top AI researchers are leaving Google to launch their own startup
description: The legendary Google executive is joined by other outgoing Google execs in a joint mission to use AI to push forward the process of scientific discovery.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Shopify says AI search is driving more traffic and sales, not replacing Google
description: Shopify says AI isn’t cannibalizing search traffic the way it has for publishers. Instead, AI-driven traffic and orders to Shopify stores tripled year over year in Q2.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Hark previews its browser use agent for completing tasks
description: Hark claims that its browser use agent is faster and cheaper than competition.
author: Ivan Mehta
